plan.scene: A bright summer afternoon on a sloping street in a small Japanese seaside town: white and pastel houses with tiled roofs, utility poles with crossing wires, huge white cumulus clouds in a deep blue sky, an old fisherman in a straw hat sitting on a wooden crate at the left edge, a schoolgirl in a sailor uniform walking a small corgi, a flock of seagulls on the asphalt, three orange-and-white traffic cones standing in the street, a low concrete seawall ledge along the right side with glittering blue ocean beyond, and a small sky-blue kei truck parked beside it; strong clear sunlight with crisp shadows, filmed with a low wide-angle lens.

shots.what: one continuous low follow shot: the skateboarder pushes down the street past the seated fisherman and the schoolgirl with the corgi, ollies high over the three cones as the seagulls burst into the air, grinds along the seawall ledge past the blue truck, rolls toward the camera, steps off the board and leans into the lens grinning with rock-on hand signs

subjects.traits: an anime teenage girl with a short messy light-blue bob and a small hair clip, big blue eyes, an oversized bright yellow hoodie, black cargo shorts, white crew socks and red high-top sneakers, riding a skateboard with a white deck

constraints: Japanese TV anime style for the whole frame: clean cel shading, crisp line art, flat vivid colors and hand-painted backgrounds, never photorealistic and never 3D
The skateboarder is the same light-blue-haired anime girl in the yellow hoodie in every frame, including the final close-up of her face
No text, letters, signs or logos anywhere
